name: @charter/ts
description: charter's TypeScript library, the counterpart of go/: the AsyncAPI generator for oRPC, both specs from one contract, the command behind a spec.ts, follow(), the gap-free feed, and auth: bearer tokens, Cloudflare Access and an OpenID Connect issuer, verified with jose. It ships compiled (dist/, written by npm run build: Node won't strip the types of a package in node_modules). A project brings oRPC and Zod itself (peerDependencies; jose comes with the library) and takes the library as the package attached to each GitHub release (mise run ts:dist writes it; the version is the release's), or in this repo as "file:../../ts"; devDependencies are what the library's own build and checks use.
